description: PyGoat (Python, Django plus Flask/Django dockerized labs): every lab vulnerability documented in the lab pages, Solutions/solution.md, dockerized lab READMEs and code comments, labeled at the server-side sink or template/client-side sink.

vulnerabilities.description: sql_lab concatenates the POSTed name and password into a raw SQL string and executes it with login.objects.raw(), allowing login bypass as admin.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A1 Sql Injection; mitre_top3.html lab details (/sql_lab)

vulnerabilities.description: injection_sql_lab builds a SQL string from POSTed name/password (line 864) and executes it with sql_lab_table.objects.raw().
vulnerabilities.note: 2021 A3 Injection lab (Lab_2021/A3_Injection/sql_lab.html); mitre_top4.html Lab 3

vulnerabilities.description: cmd_lab formats the user-supplied domain into an nslookup/dig command and runs it with subprocess.Popen(shell=True), allowing command chaining.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md Command Injection Lab 1; Lab/CMD/cmd.html; mitre_top6.html

vulnerabilities.description: cmd_lab2 passes the POSTed expression straight to eval(), giving arbitrary Python code execution.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md Command Injection Lab 2; Lab/CMD/cmd.html (eval lab)

vulnerabilities.description: a9_lab2 evaluates the user-supplied function string with PIL ImageMath.eval (Pillow 8.0.0), allowing code execution such as exec(exit()).
vulnerabilities.note: Lab/A9/a9.html Lab 2; Solutions/solution.md 2021-A6 lab-2

vulnerabilities.description: mitre_lab_17_api builds "nmap " + ip from POST data (line 241) and command_out runs it with subprocess.Popen(shell=True).
vulnerabilities.note: mitre/mitre_top17.html CWE-77 Command Injection lab

vulnerabilities.description: mitre_lab_25_api evaluates the POSTed calculator expression with eval(), giving code execution.
vulnerabilities.note: mitre/mitre_top25.html CWE-94 Code Injection lab

vulnerabilities.description: ssti_lab writes the user's blog content (filter_blog is a no-op) into a Django template file that is later rendered by ssti_view_blog, allowing server-side template injection.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A3 Server side Template Injection; mitre_top4.html Lab 1; Lab_2021/A3_Injection/ssti.html

vulnerabilities.description: a10_lab2 logs the unsanitized POSTed username on failed login, so newlines let an attacker forge log entries.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A9 Insufficient Logging; Lab/A10/a10.html Lab 2

vulnerabilities.description: a10_lab2 also logs the unsanitized username on the successful-login path (warning and info), enabling log forging.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A9; Lab/A10/a10.html Lab 2 (second sink of the same lab)

vulnerabilities.description: The search query from xss_lab is reflected with {{query|safe}}, disabling autoescaping (reflected XSS).
vulnerabilities.note: Lab/XSS/xss.html Lab 1 and mitigation section; Solutions/solution.md A7

vulnerabilities.description: The POSTed username, only stripped of literal
vulnerabilities.note: Lab/XSS/xss.html Lab 2 details

vulnerabilities.description: User input with alphanumerics removed is placed directly inside a <script> block, so JSFuck-style payloads execute.
vulnerabilities.note: Lab/XSS/xss.html Lab 3 details; Solutions/solution.md A7 Lab 3

vulnerabilities.description: The username GET parameter is rendered with |safe, letting an injected script rewrite the download link to a malicious file.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A8 Software and Data Integrity failure; A8 desc.html Lab 2; mitre_top2.html

vulnerabilities.description: insec_des_lab base64-decodes the token cookie and passes it to pickle.loads(), allowing role tampering and code execution.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A8 Insecure Deserialization; Lab_2021 A8 desc.html Lab 1

vulnerabilities.description: a9_lab loads the uploaded YAML with yaml.load(file, yaml.Loader), so !!python/object/apply tags execute commands.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A9 Using Components with Known Vulnerability; Lab/A9/a9.html Lab 1

vulnerabilities.description: deserialize_data passes base64-decoded user-supplied data to pickle.loads() without validation.
vulnerabilities.note: dockerized_labs/insec_des_lab/README.md Vulnerability Details; code comment 'Intentionally vulnerable deserialization'

vulnerabilities.description: xxe_parse enables external general entities on the SAX parser and parses the request body, allowing file disclosure via XXE.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A4 XML External Entities; Lab/XXE/xxe.html

vulnerabilities.description: ssrf_lab joins the POSTed blog path onto the app directory and opens it without validation, so ../.env and other files can be read.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021 A10 SSRF (lab 1, find ../.env); mitre_top8.html CWE-22 lab; Lab/ssrf/ssrf.html Lab 1

vulnerabilities.description: ssrf_lab2 fetches an arbitrary user-supplied URL with requests.get(), reaching localhost-only pages such as /ssrf_target.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021 A10 SSRF lab2; Lab/ssrf/ssrf.html Lab 2; mitre_top21.html Lab 2

vulnerabilities.description: ba_lab grants admin data whenever the client-controlled admin cookie equals "1".
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A5 Broken Access Control; Lab/BrokenAccess/ba.html

vulnerabilities.description: a1_broken_access_lab_1 trusts the client-controlled admin cookie value "1" to reveal the admin secret.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A1 Lab 1; Lab_2021/A1_BrokenAccessControl/broken_access.html Lab 1

vulnerabilities.description: a1_broken_access_lab_2 treats any request with User-Agent "pygoat_admin" as admin.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A1 Lab 2; broken_access.html Lab 2

vulnerabilities.description: a1_broken_access_lab3_secret renders the admin secret page with no admin check, so any logged-in user can browse to it directly.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A1 Lab 3; broken_access.html Lab 3; code comment 'no checking applied here'

vulnerabilities.description: secret() reveals the secret key when the client-supplied X-Host header equals admin.localhost:8000.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A6 Security Misconfiguration; Lab/sec_mis/sec_mis.html Lab 1

vulnerabilities.description: all_users_data_view returns every user's full credit card, SSN and API key with no authentication or authorization check.
vulnerabilities.note: dockerized_labs/sensitive_data_exposure/README.md flaws 3, 6, 7; code comment 'MAJOR SECURITY FLAW'

vulnerabilities.description: auth_lab_login logs a user in purely from the sequential userid cookie, so changing it impersonates other users.
vulnerabilities.note: Lab/AUTH/auth_home.html (Broken Authentication, 'think about cookies') and auth_lab.html 'Can You Log in as other user?'

vulnerabilities.description: Otp verifies the 3-digit admin OTP with no rate limiting or attempt counter, so it can be brute-forced.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A2 Broken Authentication; Lab/BrokenAuth/bau.html; Lab_2021 a7.html Lab 1

vulnerabilities.description: crypto_failure_lab3 grants admin when the unsigned "username|timestamp" cookie starts with admin.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A2 Lab 3; crypto_failure.html Lab 3

vulnerabilities.description: auth_failure_lab2 locks the admin account for 24 hours after 5 failed attempts by anyone, letting an attacker lock out the real admin.
vulnerabilities.note: Lab_2021/A7_auth_failure/a7.html Lab 2 ('do something else so that real admin can't access the admin panel')

vulnerabilities.description: auth_failure_lab3 logout only blanks the session_id cookie and never deletes the AF_session_id record, so old session tokens keep working.
vulnerabilities.note: Lab_2021/A7_auth_failure/a7.html Lab 3; A7 discussion api expects AF_session_id...delete()

vulnerabilities.description: login compares plaintext passwords with no brute-force protection.
vulnerabilities.note: dockerized_labs/broken_auth_lab/README.md items 2 and 6; code comment 'Plain text password comparison'

vulnerabilities.description: The session token is just base64(username:timestamp), which is predictable and forgeable.
vulnerabilities.note: broken_auth_lab/README.md item 3 / exercise 2; code comment 'Insecure session management'

vulnerabilities.description: Remember me stores the forgeable session token in a 30-day persistent cookie without HttpOnly/Secure.
vulnerabilities.note: broken_auth_lab/README.md item 4; code comment 'Insecure Remember Me implementation'

vulnerabilities.description: register accepts any non-empty password with no complexity requirements.
vulnerabilities.note: broken_auth_lab/README.md item 1 / exercise 1; code comment 'No password complexity requirements'

vulnerabilities.description: register stores new users' passwords in plaintext.
vulnerabilities.note: broken_auth_lab/README.md item 2; code comment 'Storing plain text passwords'

vulnerabilities.description: dashboard takes the username from the base64 session cookie without verification, so a forged cookie logs in as admin (role escalation).
vulnerabilities.note: broken_auth_lab/README.md exercises 2 and 4; code comment 'Insecure session validation'

vulnerabilities.description: crypto_failure_lab hashes passwords with unsalted MD5, so leaked hashes are trivially reversed.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A2 Lab 1; crypto_failure.html Lab 1

vulnerabilities.description: customHash is an unsalted, fast SHA-256 with the hex reversed, used for crypto_failure_lab2 passwords and easily cracked.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md 2021-A2 Lab 2 ('custom function is used'); crypto_failure.html Lab 2

vulnerabilities.description: Password reset tokens are MD5(email:timestamp), which is predictable.
vulnerabilities.note: broken_auth_lab/README.md item 5 / exercise 3; code comment 'Predictable token generation'

vulnerabilities.description: API keys are generated with the non-cryptographic random.choices.
vulnerabilities.note: code comments in generate_api_key ('should probably use a better method'), 'not very secure api key'

vulnerabilities.description: The JWT signing key SECRET_COOKIE_KEY is a hardcoded weak value ("PYGOAT"), exposed via the debug page, letting attackers forge an admin auth_cookie.
vulnerabilities.note: Lab/sec_mis/sec_mis.html Lab 3 ('solve lab2 before this', login as admin) and sec_mis_lab3.html code view

vulnerabilities.description: Flask app.secret_key is hardcoded.
vulnerabilities.note: code comment 'Vulnerable: Hardcoded secret key' in broken_auth_lab/app.py

vulnerabilities.description: The admin account has a hardcoded weak password (admin123).
vulnerabilities.note: code comment 'Vulnerable: Weak password'; broken_auth_lab/README.md default credentials

vulnerabilities.description: The regular user account has a hardcoded weak password (password123).
vulnerabilities.note: code comment 'Vulnerable: Weak password'; broken_auth_lab/README.md default credentials

vulnerabilities.description: DEBUG = True makes 500/404 errors dump settings, including SENSITIVE_DATA and SECRET_COOKIE_KEY.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A3 Sensitive Data Exposure; Lab/DataExp/data_exp.html; Lab/sec_mis/sec_mis.html Lab 2

vulnerabilities.description: The Flask app runs with debug=True on 0.0.0.0.
vulnerabilities.note: broken_auth_lab/README.md item 7; code comment 'Debug mode enabled in production'

vulnerabilities.description: The unauthenticated /debug route serves a log file containing a request with credentials in the query string.
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md A10 Insufficient Logging & Monitoring; Lab/A10/a10.html Lab 1

vulnerabilities.description: The password reset link and token are shown to whoever requests the reset instead of being emailed.
vulnerabilities.note: code comment 'Vulnerable: Token exposed in response'; broken_auth_lab/README.md exercise 3

vulnerabilities.description: The profile page emits the full credit card, SSN and API key inside an HTML comment.
vulnerabilities.note: dockerized_labs/sensitive_data_exposure/README.md flaw 1 (comments in HTML)

vulnerabilities.description: Client-side JavaScript embeds the user's API key in a global variable.
vulnerabilities.note: sensitive_data_exposure/README.md flaw 2 (JavaScript that exposes API keys)

vulnerabilities.description: Client-side JavaScript stores the API key in localStorage.
vulnerabilities.note: sensitive_data_exposure/README.md flaw 4 (data stored in localStorage)

vulnerabilities.description: api_data_view returns the full, unmasked credit card, SSN and API key as JSON.
vulnerabilities.note: sensitive_data_exposure/README.md flaws 3 and 5; code comment 'Intentionally exposing sensitive data through API'

vulnerabilities.description: Credit card numbers and SSNs are stored unencrypted in the database.
vulnerabilities.note: code comments 'probly should encrypt this', 'security risk!' in models.py

vulnerabilities.description: insec_desgine_lab limits free tickets per account only, so creating multiple accounts claims all tickets (insecure design / business logic).
vulnerabilities.note: Solutions/solution.md OWASP 2021 A4 Insecure Design; Lab/A11/a11.html

vulnerabilities.description: csrf_transfer_monei_api transfers money on a plain GET authenticated only by a cookie, with no CSRF token, so a cross-site link can make the victim transfer funds.
vulnerabilities.note: mitre/mitre_top9.html CWE-352 CSRF lab (bank transfer)
